• Grande senso di responsabilità, uno stile di comunicazione aperto e piacevole e la disponibilità a collaborare interdisciplinare/interprof-sional.

Become part of something bigger. Work together with over 2000 specialists from more than 100 professions and enable people with paraplegia to live a self-determined life. On the modern campus in Nottwil, an inspiring atmosphere and interdisciplinary cooperation on an eye level awaits you. We are looking for an assistant physician in the field of neurosurgery or orthopaedic surgery and traumatology of the musculoskeletal system with interest and experience in the field of spinal surgery as of summer 2026. The employment is initially limited for a year. Upon obtaining the specialist status and outstanding application, a promotion to the doctor and an extension of the work relationship with mutual consent is possible, with the option of partial or complete training for the focus of spinal surgery. These are your tasks
• You are supervising a cadre doctor and you are taking care of patients in the surgical consultation session of the Wirbelsäule and you are supporting them in the care of inpatients
• You are responsible for operations, infiltration of the spine and the large joints and can perform such under supervision yourself depending on your level of training
• You are relieved of administrative burdens by the department of acute and rehabilitation medicine in the hospital care of patients, thereby focusing more on the medical concerns you work closely with the colleagues of acute medicine, rehabilitation, pain clinic, plastic surgery, radiology, physiotherapy, occupational therapy and many other departments
• you actively participate in teaching, research and further education This is what distinguishes you
• you have several years of clinical experience with a recognizable focus on the spinalem. Ideally, you are about to complete your specialist training and intend to complete the specialization in spinal surgery (SGNC/SO).
• You have a degree in medicine (with foreign diplomas with MEBEKO recognition) and have very good oral and written German knowledge (at least level C1).
• You are a highly capable, committed and resilient personality with a high social and professional competence.
• Great sense of responsibility, an open and pleasant communication style and the willingness to cooperate interdisciplinary/interprof-essional.
• Scientific experience is of benefit in the event of an application. This awaits you About us The Swiss Paraplegic Center in Nottwil is a private, national and internationally recognized specialist clinic for cross-sectional, back and ventilation medicine. As an acute and rehabilitation clinic, the center offers its patients comprehensive care and supports them for a lifetime. The clinic belongs to the Swiss Paraplegic Group, which provides a worldwide unique service network for the holistic rehabilitation of people with spinal cord injury. Tasks:
• You take care of patients under supervision of a cadre doctor in the Wirbelsäule-CHirurgische consultation session and support them in the care of inpatient patients Requirements:
• You have several years of clinical experience with a recognizable focus on the spinal embolden. Ideally, you are about to complete your specialist training and intend to complete the specialization in spinal surgery (SGNC/SO).

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il dolore neuropatico è una condizione di salute secondaria grave e debilitante dopo la lesione del midollo spinale (SCI). Probabilmente comporta interazioni cerebrali-spinali anormali, tra cui ipereccitabilità spinale e modulazione del dolore alterata nel cervello, ma le prove negli esseri umani sono ancora mancanti a causa della mancanza di protocolli di imaging per misurare l'attività del midollo spinale. In questo studio multicentro (Swiss Paraplegic Research / Balgrist University Hospital), studieremo il dolore neuropatico in SCI utilizzando cervello e midollo spinale fMRI. Dopo aver istituito e convalidato un nuovo protocollo fMRI del cavo lumbosacrale attraverso i due centri, valuteremo la sensibilizzazione spinale e l'attività cerebrale anormale legata al dolore neuropatico nelle persone con SCI. descriptionByLocale.en:
Neuropathic pain is a major, debilitating secondary health condition after spinal cord injury (SCI). It likely involves abnormal brain–spinal interactions, including spinal hyperexcitability and altered pain modulation in the brain, but evidence in humans is still missing due to the lack of imaging protocols to measure spinal cord activity.

In this multicentre study (Swiss Paraplegic Research / Balgrist University Hospital), we will investigate neuropathic pain in SCI using brain and spinal cord fMRI. After setting up and validating a novel lumbosacral cord fMRI protocol across the two centres, we will assess spinal sensitisation and abnormal brain activity linked to neuropathic pain in individuals with SCI. As part of the PhD thesis, the student is expected to take an active role in all the aspects of the project, including study conceptualization and design, preparation of the ethical application, data collection and analysis, and publication of the results. Aufgaben: • Contribution to study conceptualization and design • Writing and submission of study documents for approval by ethics committees or authorities • Enrolment of study participants, data collection, analysis and interpretation • Writing and submission of publications in high impact, peer-reviewed journals • Presentation of research findings at national and international conferences Anforderungen: • Master degree in neuroscience, psychology, biology, biomedical engineering or similar, acceptable for matriculation at a Swiss University (Bologna compatible) • Interest in neuroimaging methods, with particular focus on functional MRI • Knowledge in Matlab and/or RStudio • Willingness to work with patients in clinical settings • Proactive, good communication skills and attitude to team-work • Excellent knowledge in both German and English, mother tongue German is preferred • Willingness to travel regularly between Zurich and Nottwil (Lucerne) Wir bieten: You can expect attractive employment conditions as well as numerous other advantages. The mission of SPF is sustainably improving the situation of people with spinal cord injury (SCI) through interdisciplinary, clinical and Community-based research on a national and international level. Specific areas of its comprehensive research include functioning, mobility, social integration, equality of opportunity, self-determination, quality of life, health services provision as well as epidemiology and statistical methods. SPF is an university research institution recognized and promoted by the Swiss federal government and the cantons and an active link to academic and industrial research and development at the national and international levels.

Neuropathische Schmerzen sind ein wichtiger, schwächender sekundärer Gesundheitszustand nach Rückenmarksverletzungen (SCI). Es handelt sich wahrscheinlich um abnorme Gehirn-Rückenmark-Interaktionen, einschließlich der spinalen Hypererregbarkeit und veränderter Schmerzmodulation im Gehirn, aber Beweise beim Menschen fehlen immer noch aufgrund des Mangels an Bildgebungsprotokollen zur Messung der Rückenmarksaktivität. In dieser multizentrischen Studie (Swiss Paraplegic Research / Balgrist University Hospital) werden wir neuropathische Schmerzen bei SCI mithilfe von Gehirn- und Rückenmark-fMRI untersuchen. Nach der Einrichtung und Validierung eines neuartigen lumbosakralen fMRI-Protokolls in den beiden Zentren werden wir die Wirbelsäulensensibilisierung und abnormale Gehirnaktivität im Zusammenhang mit neuropathischen Schmerzen bei Personen mit SCI bewerten. Im Rahmen der Doktorarbeit wird erwartet, dass der Student eine aktive Rolle in allen Aspekten des Projekts einnimmt, einschließlich Studienkonzeption und -design, Vorbereitung der ethischen Anwendung, Datensammlung und -analyse und Veröffentlichung der Ergebnisse. La douleur neuropathique est une maladie secondaire grave et débilitante après une lésion de la moelle épinière (SCI). Il s'agit probablement d'interactions cérébrales et spinales anormales, y compris une hyperexcitabilité de la moelle épinière et une modulation de la douleur altérée dans le cerveau, mais les données chez l'homme sont toujours manquantes en raison de l'absence de protocoles d'imagerie pour mesurer l'activité de la moelle épinière.

Dans cette étude multicentrique (Swiss Paraplégic Research / Balgrist University Hospital), nous étudierons la douleur neuropathique dans le SCI en utilisant l'IRMf du cerveau et de la moelle épinière. Après la mise en place et la validation d'un nouveau protocole d'IRMf à cordon lombosacral dans les deux centres, nous évaluerons la sensibilisation de la colonne vertébrale et l'activité cérébrale anormale liée à la douleur neuropathique chez les personnes atteintes d'ICS. Dans le cadre de la thèse de doctorat, l'étudiant devrait jouer un rôle actif dans tous les aspects du projet, y compris la conceptualisation et la conception des études, la préparation de l'application éthique, la collecte et l'analyse des données et la publication des résultats.
